title: Compound Interest Calculator
h1: Compound Interest Calculator — Future Value & Interest
description: Calculate compound interest and future value from principal, annual rate, time and compounding frequency. Supports yearly through daily compounding, all client-side.
intro: Enter the principal, annual interest rate, number of years and compounding frequency. The tool shows the future value, total interest earned and a simple year-by-year balance.
blurb: See how money grows with compounding — yearly, quarterly, monthly or daily — including total interest and final amount.
howItWorks: The standard compound interest formula A = P × (1 + r/n)^(n×t) is applied, where r is the annual rate as a decimal and n is the compounding periods per year.
Future value A includes principal plus all compounded interest. Total interest earned is A minus P.
A year-by-year schedule shows the balance at the end of each complete year using the same rate and frequency.
examples: $10,000 at 5% compounded yearly for 10 years becomes approximately $16,288.95.
The same $10,000 at 5% compounded monthly for 10 years becomes approximately $16,470.09.
At 8% yearly for 5 years on $5,000 the future value is about $7,346.64.

faq.q: Which compounding frequencies can I choose?
faq.a: Yearly (once a year), half-yearly, quarterly, monthly and daily (365 times per year).
The final future value uses the exact fractional years you enter. The schedule only lists complete years.

faq.q: Is the calculation accurate for large numbers?
faq.a: Yes, within normal JavaScript number precision. Results are shown to two decimal places.
